title: 3:42 AM
logline: If they want garbage, I will build them a cathedral of garbage.

margin.note: No mark during the parody week.

panels.composition: The garage at night. WOOD in front of a glowing CRT monitor in the dark. The clock reads 3:42 AM. An empty two-liter of generic citrus soda beside a pile of crumpled bristol.

characters.pose: hunched at a CRT, typing, eyes bloodshot

balloons.text: If they want garbage, I will build them a cathedral of garbage.

image.prompt: a bloodshot young man hunched at a glowing CRT monitor in a dark garage apartment at 3:42 AM, saturated monitor glow cutting the dark, an empty two-liter soda bottle and crumpled paper, jagged hyperactive linework

panels.composition: His trembling hand hand-lettering a title banner: R-O-L-F-C-O-P-T-R.

image.prompt: extreme close-up of a trembling ink-stained hand lettering crude block letters on bristol board under monitor glow
image.notes: The one place lettering IS the art: the generator may letter ROLFCOPTR (misspelled) on the banner. If it garbles, letter it after.

balloons.text: It will run for one week. A scorched-earth parody. Then I return to the serious timber-faller allegory.

image.prompt: a feverish young man muttering at his drafting table lit only by a CRT, jagged linework, neon glow on his face

panels.composition: The CRT screen flashes white: Bandwidth Limit Exceeded (509 Error). BARNABY lifts his head from the dog bed, lets out a single sigh, goes back to sleep.

characters.pose: frozen, lit white by the screen
head lifted from the bed, sighing

image.prompt: a CRT screen flashing pure white lighting a stunned young man's face in a dark garage, a low-slung terrier lifting its head from a dog bed under the desk with a sigh

notes: The parody itself ran beside this. This is the Drift Wood daily about making it.
